answer: Nobody is waved through free: an examination charge of $9, charged again each time a name fails is the price, and the reef never covers it twice. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. No Tested map engraver vat token, no seat: the rule is plain, and a token engravers wear after workshop inspections is why it holds. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. spiral stays on the record. Every hollow is counted once.
